scope: Warm authored metadata component. Three alternating samples per size/profile/workload. No media/model/transport/cold-cache/physical-power/ranking result; caches and background remain uncontrolled.
limitations: Three pairs do not establish statistical significance
Uncontrolled caches and unrelated background activity
Calendar source-only work in separate checkout; no concurrent local compilers/tests
Baseline includes common unused helper and identical new tests
No late-record scale, media/model/transport, cold cache, physical power or ranking acceptance
sourceScope: Compiled sources/tests/tools/assets only; baseline uses published b38 writer plus the same unused retired-dependency helper and five new late-dependency test files as candidate. Writer is the sole differing compiled input.

negativeControls.reason: Root or local causal frontier missing
Identity lookup index differs from pinned build
